proposals.evidence: DEDR 784 gives Tamil/Malayalam eṭṭu, Kannada eṇṭu, Kota eṭ, Telugu enimidi and Kolami enumidi ‘eight’. The parent is printed entry 784, not d783, whose current reconstruction label misleadingly says eight over a different primary article. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
